claude.performance_metric: no divestiture; acquired business folded from a standalone "Innovation Systems" segment (through FY2019) into three multi-legacy segments effective Jan 1, 2020, structure persisting through FY2022; $6,259M acquisition goodwill retained
claude.rationale: The slice documents an integration that persisted (the acquired business was absorbed into Aeronautics/Defense/Space Systems segments and retained through FY2022) with no documented product/process incoherence realized over time, so p4_pathway is 0. For p5_pathway, the record shows the opposite of an operations-vs-organization fracture: pre-merger Orbital ATK executives (COO, Space Systems Group head) show biographical continuity into post-reorganization Space Systems leadership, and no disruption at the process/organization interface is documented, so p5_pathway is 0. Segment-level goodwill impairment balances ($417M Aeronautics, $153M Space) are explicitly stated to include legacy businesses beyond Orbital ATK and cannot be isolated to the acquired entity, so they do not evidence a specific pathway. The slice gives no evidence bearing on the controlling-intent archetype's realized coherence, hence t1_archetype is uncertain; no business-model incompatibility is documented, so t2_model is 0.

grok.performance_metric: no divestiture; assets retained; Innovation Systems folded into multi-legacy segments (2020)
grok.rationale: The slice documents no realized product/process interface disruption: legacy Innovation Systems results were simply reallocated across Aeronautics, Defense, and Space Systems segments effective 1 Jan 2020, with purchase goodwill explicitly tied to expected integration synergies and no product-line incoherence reported (FY2020/FY2022 10-Ks). Likewise no process/organization fracture is documented; pre-merger Orbital ATK executives continued into Former Innovation Systems and then Space Systems leadership roles, and the only lingering item is an active FTC-order disclosure, not an operations-vs-organization break.

openai.performance_metric: legacy business embedded across 3 segments through FY2022
openai.rationale: The slice documents that legacy Innovation Systems was reorganized across three segments beginning in 2020, but it does not report product-line or operating-process incoherence; therefore no p4 disruption is documented. It also reports continuity of former Orbital ATK executives into post-reorganization leadership roles and provides no evidence that operational integration fractured against management, workforce, or culture, so no p5 disruption is documented.
